applications.name: VideoBoss
applications.productPurpose: Plan sequences and shots, choose bounded render routes, compare takes, protect continuity, and deliver an evidence-backed video package.
applications.releaseStatus: Planning, simulated rendering, review, and export work now. Connect a supported server-side provider to render real video.

applications.name: ImageHoss
applications.productPurpose: Direct images with role-aware references, compare candidates, accept durable Assets, keep rights and provenance, and hand results to VideoBoss.
applications.releaseStatus: Configuration, compiled previews, portability, and deterministic demonstration work now.
applications.unavailableReason: To make real images, start the authenticated local ImageHoss bridge and its project-scoped ComfyUI runtime. You can keep configuring or use the demonstration route now.

applications.name: Meshmallow
applications.productPurpose: Shape an editable world and scene plan, approve bounded Blender operations, inspect checkpoints, and export source and engine packages.
applications.releaseStatus: World planning, compiled previews, mock execution, and package validation work now; legacy 3D Bee identity remains in IDs and protocols.
applications.unavailableReason: To build real 3D files, pair the authenticated Meshmallow supervisor and a supported Blender runtime, then approve the exact operation plan. You can keep planning or use mock mode now.

applications.name: Gummy Rooms
applications.productPurpose: Collaborative AI rooms and social presence with fair queues, live streaming, isolated threads, live mirrors, Actors, and Bowls.
applications.unavailableReason: No authenticated Gummy Rooms service is connected. The product remains visible while Actor, Bowl, Grant, and Receipt integration is staged.
